method.description: sampled the accepted sanitized glTF at normalized times 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 and 1.00; applied the actual joint hierarchy, animation TRS, inverse bind matrices and four-influence skinning; visually compared both skinned-mesh and skeleton poses; used channel-value comparison only to distinguish visually subtle No/Yes neck-head rotational paths

reviewed_clips.Death: large whole-body orientation and silhouette transition away from the starting airborne pose; the final sample remains markedly displaced instead of cycling back to the start
reviewed_clips.Fast_Flying: rapid bilateral wing and body oscillation across the clip with a cyclic return close to the starting pose
reviewed_clips.Flying_Idle: slower bilateral wing and body hover-like oscillation with a cyclic return close to the starting pose
reviewed_clips.Headbutt: pronounced early forward/downward head-and-torso drive followed by recovery toward the starting airborne pose; the forelimbs are not the dominant moving silhouette
reviewed_clips.HitReact: short whole-body recoil/offset that peaks early-to-mid clip and recovers toward the starting pose
reviewed_clips.No: repeating neck/head orientation swing over an otherwise shared airborne body cycle; the motion returns near the starting orientation
reviewed_clips.Punch: one forelimb raises and extends prominently through the early/middle samples while the torso follows, then the limb retracts toward the starting pose
reviewed_clips.Yes: repeating neck/head orientation change on a different rotational path from No over the shared airborne body cycle, returning near the starting orientation

logical_binding.note: The production Region 01 logical presentation profile now exists and defines server-facing logical animation keys for all attack phases, but source-clip gameplay mappings remain NOT_AUTHORED. Do not derive mappings from source clip names or treat reviewed source ACTION windows as server ACTIVE timing; bind a clip only after its observed motion is explicitly reviewed against the intended authoritative gameplay role. Arena pressure currently has no approved source-motion mapping.
